class.name: NetwLinkConditions
class.description: [method NetwSessionConfig.link] applies conditions to real connections only in debug builds. Default values add no delay or loss. RTT targets are for the client monitor on localhost at 60 ticks/s and 120 FPS. [codeblock] Netw.configure_session(self).link(NetwLinkConditions.wifi()) [/codeblock]

method.name: mobile_4g
method.description: [codeblock lang=text] Target RTT 85 ms Jitter 0 to 25 ms Loss 3% Reordering 2% Duplication 0.2% Stalls 1% for 80 ms [/codeblock]

method.name: poor_3g
method.description: [codeblock lang=text] Target RTT 220 ms Jitter 0 to 90 ms Loss 8% Reordering 5% Duplication 0.5% Stalls 4% for 250 ms [/codeblock]

method.name: satellite
method.description: [codeblock lang=text] Target RTT 650 ms Jitter 0 to 120 ms Loss 4% Reordering 3% Duplication 0.3% Stalls 2% for 400 ms [/codeblock]

method.name: wifi
method.description: [codeblock lang=text] Target RTT 40 ms Jitter 0 to 8 ms Loss 1% Reordering 0.5% Duplication 0.1% Stalls Off [/codeblock]
